newsitem.title: USA: Vintage acquires properties from Burlington.
newsitem.headline: Vintage acquires properties from Burlington.

text.p: Vintage Petroleum Inc said Tuesday it completed its purchase of $101.4 million in producing properties and facilities in the Gulf Coast of Texas and Louisiana from subsidiaries of Burlington Resources Inc.
Vintage said it paid cash for the properties.
Vintage said the acquisition adds 28.5 million equivalent barrels (BOE) of proved reserves to Vintage's reserve base which stood at 242.1 million BOE at year-end 1996.

Vintage said the properties acquired consist of several key onshore fields, five offshore fields and a number of smaller fields covering over 74,000 net acres, about 46 percent of which are associated with offshore fields.
Vintage said it now operates the properties which have current net daily production averaging about 5,200 barrels of crude oil and 17 million cubic feet.
